messages.subject: Bayesian Mediation Analysis With Latent Variables
messages.subject_clean: Bayesian Mediation Analysis With Latent Variables
messages.body_plain:
Dear list members,

I wonder whether I could run a mediation Analysis including latent variables in blavaan, such as it is easily implemented with lavaan :
library(lavaan)
  model <- '
   # latent variables
     X =~ x1 + x2 + x3
     M =~ y1 + y2 + y3 + y4
     Y =~ y5 + y6 + y7 + y8

  fit <- sem(model,data=PoliticalDemocracy)
  summary(fit)

  model <- ' # direct effect
             Y ~ c*X
           # mediator
             M ~ a*X
             Y ~ b*M
           # indirect effect (a*b)
             ab := a*b
           # total effect
             total := c + (a*b)
         '
  fit <- sem(model, data = PoliticalDemocracy)
  summary(fit)

P.D. I think one option in the Bayesian context would be the R2OpenBUGS package:
https://psycnet.apa.org/record/2019-78964-001

However, it would be nice to know whether I could use blavaan for the same analysis.

Thanks in advance and the best regards,

Hi everyone,

I'm circling around on this (sorry to be offline from it for a while). I downloaded the updated version from github, and tested out the blavPredict() function on the situation I mentioned above, where there is regression with missingness on the outcome. I also tested it out on a regression model with missingness on the outcome and on the predictor. In both cases it seems to be giving me results for the distribution of the missing values that match those from JAGS. Thanks for addressing this!

I hope to return to the possibilities for getting posterior predicted data shortly.

Thanks,
Roy

messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone,
I ran into some problems estimating models that contained equality constraints. Either the Sampler did not start or it completely ignored the equality constraints. This is the model syntax:

Maintenance =~ NA*Pc_Color_NoUp + b1*Pc_Color_NoUp + b2*Pc_Letter_NoUp + b3*Pc_Number_NoUp + b4*Pc_Color_Upd + b5*Pc_Letter_Upd + b6*Pc_Number_Upd
Maintenance ~~ 1*Maintenance

Updating =~  NA*Pc_Color_Upd + b7*Pc_Color_Upd + b8*Pc_Letter_Upd + b9*Pc_Number_Upd
Updating ~~ 1*Updating

# Residual covariances for same material
Pc_Color_NoUp ~~ NA*Pc_Color_Upd
Pc_Letter_NoUp ~~ NA*Pc_Letter_Upd
Pc_Number_NoUp ~~ NA*Pc_Number_Upd

# Constrain error variances
Pc_Color_NoUp  ~~ e1*Pc_Color_NoUp
Pc_Letter_NoUp ~~ e2*Pc_Letter_NoUp
Pc_Number_NoUp ~~ e3*Pc_Number_NoUp

Pc_Color_Upd   ~~ e4*Pc_Color_Upd
Pc_Letter_Upd  ~~ e5*Pc_Letter_Upd
Pc_Number_Upd  ~~ e6*Pc_Number_Upd

# equality constraints
b5 == (b4/b7) * b8
b6 == (b4/b7) * b9

I ensured that only one variable is on the left hand side of the equation. But Stan still does not start to sample or ignores the equality contraint (Slack > 50). Are there any other options to specify equality constraints? Or do I miss some error in the specification. In lavaan the model runs as I would expect and meets the equality constraints.
Thanks in advance for any suggestions or comments.
Best, Gidon
